preconditions.description: The number of files to be deleted (m) is between 1 and the total number of files (n), inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a_indices)
preconditions.description: All indices of files to be deleted are within the range [1, n].
All indices of files to be deleted are distinct.
Each filename has a length of at most 100 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(filename.isalnum() or filename == '.' for filename in ''.join(filenames))
preconditions.description: Filenames contain only lowercase English letters, digits, and dots ('.').

postconditions.description: The output is either 'No' or starts with 'Yes\n'.
If a pattern exists, it has the same length as the filenames.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'No' or all(matches_pattern(filenames[i-1], return_value.split('\n')[1]) for i in a_indices)
postconditions.description: All files to be deleted match the pattern.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'No' or all(not matches_pattern(filenames[i-1], return_value.split('\n')[1]) for i in range(1, n+1) if i not in a_indices)
postconditions.description: All other files do not match the pattern.
